text.description_html:
Fusion DRDS, Hinge Pin Door Saver

For use on a hinged door where a standard door stop is not desirable, this universal fit door stop is mounted on a door hinge pin instead of on the floor or baseboard. Easily adjustable, simple to use, out of the way and out of sight. Made by Fusion, the DRDS Hinge Pin Door Stop will not damage doors. PVD Lifetime Polished Brass

Features and Specifications of the Hinge Pin Door Bumper:

  • Installs in seconds.
  • Hinge mounted to fit most doors.
  • Hole diameter: 5/16"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Packaged with all hardware.
  • Finish: PVD Lifetime Polished Brass

Sold individually.

** This is Discontinued. See available Door Stoppers.
